[[File:Demonic Offering icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Demonic Offering''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 84 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast. When cast, the spell instantly offers up to three [[Remains#Demonic ashes|demonic ashes]] in the player's inventory, granting three times the normal [[Prayer]] experience per ash for scattering them. The spell offers the first three demonic ashes in the player's inventory regardless of type. Players may only cast offering spells once every 5.4 seconds.

The spell also restores one prayer point for each ash converted; for [[infernal ashes]], two prayer points are restored instead.

The spell can be cast without runes at the [[Fountain of Rune]], which is useful for Ironmen without access to [[wrath rune]]s.
